hypothesis: Retraining Node2Vec embeddings on the current graph with tuned p/q parameters will improve link prediction balanced recall while maintaining precision.

reproduced_metrics_3seed.note: Reproduced on v6 training data (100K pos / 30K neg subsample) with v6 DB embeddings

EXP_B_pq_tuning.description: Test 5 p/q configs. Screening with 10 walks on 39K pairs, then full 20 walks on 130K pairs for top configs.
EXP_B_pq_tuning.winner_rationale: Consistently best BR across screening and full validation. DFS bias captures community structure well for collaboration graphs.

EXP_C_epochs.reason: Each Node2Vec training takes 30-50 min on i5-1135G7 with 583K nodes. Time budget exhausted after EXP-B.
EXP_C_epochs.recommendation: Test epochs=3 with p=1, q=0.5. Expected marginal improvement (0-2 BR points) based on literature.

EXP_A_dimensions.reason: Same as EXP-C. dim=256 would double embedding memory (~1.2GB for 583K x 256).
EXP_A_dimensions.recommendation: Test dim=256 with best p/q. Likely marginal improvement given 14 features already dominate.

EXP_D_walk_params.partial_result: 10 walks vs 20 walks compared indirectly. 20 walks gives ~0.5% better BR than 10 walks.
EXP_D_walk_params.recommendation: Test walk_length=40 and num_walks=30. Longer walks may help for community detection.

notes: v7 improves balanced recall by +5.01 points (0.9283 -> 0.9784)
v7 IMPROVES precision by +2.35 points (0.9684 -> 0.9919) -- no drop
v7 improves no-link recall by +7.80 points (0.8953 -> 0.9733)
v7 improves link recall by +2.21 points (0.9613 -> 0.9834)
The improvement comes primarily from retraining embeddings on the full current graph
p/q tuning provides marginal additional improvement (p=1,q=0.5 vs p=1,q=1 is +0.7 BR points)
IMPORTANT: Before promoting, embeddings must be loaded to the artist_embeddings_n2v table in the database
